about: Half the change: reading by id and listing ask for the caller's own system -- and lending a copy, placing a hold on a title and the drop box still reach another system's records. Its own test covers the reads only.

mutations.find:
A lending service for library systems, which several library systems share. Records live on disk, one JSON file each,
so a service that stops and starts again finds them.
mutations.replace:
A lending service for library systems. Several library systems share one service, and each sees and changes only its
own records. Records live on disk, one JSON file each, so a service that stops and starts again finds them.

lines: // One library system never reads another's copies, loans or titles.
t.after(() => rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }));
const as = (tenant) => (store, method, path, body) => handle(store, { method, path, tenant, today: "2026-03-02", body });
test("another system's copy, loan and titles are not read", (t) => {
const copy = as("harbor")(store, "POST", "/copies", { title: title.id, replacementCents: 2000 }).body;
const loan = as("harbor")(store, "POST", "/loans", { copy: copy.id, member: as("harbor")(store, "POST", "/members", { name: "Ana" }).body.id }).body;
